title: Fix canonical review audit event chronology across rotations

owned: Canonical review audit event chronology across active and rotated logs
Fail-closed chronology validation and focused merge-gate regressions
not_changing: Activity log rotation or archive naming
Canonical task lifecycle and review transition writers

failure_reproduction.pr_5527: A 13:48 assign event in a lexically later content-addressed archive was scanned after a 15:18 exact-head approval and incorrectly revoked it.
failure_reproduction.root_cause: Archive filename order was treated as event chronology even though rotation filenames are content hashes.

implementation.chronology_authority: Parsed UTC event timestamps after source validation; archive filenames carry no temporal authority.
fail_closed_conditions: distinct task events at one timestamp
implementation.consumer_unification: Standalone canonical review checks and auto-integrator ReviewGate already call the same load_approval_record function; chronology is implemented only there.

results: 113 tests passed, including PR #5527 rotation-order reproduction and fail-closed chronology cases

required_checks: Confirm content-hash filename order cannot supersede UTC event chronology
Confirm malformed or ambiguous multi-source histories fail closed
Confirm true post-approval assign, reopen, and do-not-merge revocations remain effective
Confirm auto-integrator and standalone gate share the same loader
